title: Calm Breeze Cottage | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Beach Cottage:* Custom Home in Beautiful Cottages of Eastern Lake* 1050 yards from Walton Dunes Beach Access* 2 Master Bedrooms, Screened in Porch, Gas Grill and; Outdoor Shower* 4 Bikes Included* Small, Quiet Complex, Private
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Beach Cottage:* Custom Home in Beautiful Cottages of Eastern Lake* 1050 yards from Walton Dunes Beach Access* 2 Master Bedrooms, Screened in Porch, Gas Grill and; Outdoor Shower* 4 Bikes Included* Small, Quiet Complex, Private Community Pool, and Nature Trails * Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Nearby Greenway Station - NEW Summer 2023!* Café 30A, Old Florida Fish House, and The Big Chill nearby* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.**We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Calm Breeze Cottage, nestled in the Cottages of Eastern Lake Community, south of 30A. This 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom custom home combines with convenience, featuring hardwood floors throughout, designer bathrooms, and a chef's kitchen complete with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas stove, and a wine cooler. You will love the beautifully decorated living area, with 2 couches to enjoy watching TV on the large flat screen. The first floor has a master king bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, and the second floor has an additional master bedroom with a full bed and ensuite bathroom, bunk room with 2 sets of twin over full bunkbeds, and one more guest bedroom with a full bed, comfortably sleeping 8 guests! Your group will enjoy the added bonus features, including 4 complimentary bikes, a screened-in back porch with an outdoor gas grill, an outdoor shower, and storage for all your beach items, which you will appreciate as you are within walking distance to the beach access! You will fall in love with Calm Breeze Cottage!Cottages at Eastern Lake is a private, sought after community, conveniently located on the south side of Scenic 30A in Seagrove Beach. The homes in Cottages at Eastern Lake are reminiscent of the Florida cottage style, full of coastal detail and charm. There is parking for 2 vehicles only. The small, quiet community offers such amenities as an elegant pool lined with palm trees, brick paver streets, and public park access to Eastern Lake just across the street, where one can enjoy kayaking, canoeing, or paddleboarding. Cottages at Eastern Lake is within 5 minutes of Seaside, and only 10 minutes from Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. This well-appointed community is also within walking distance to the beach and fabulous shopping on 30A. Many fantastic restaurants are nearby including Café Thirty-A, Chiringo, and Grayton Seafood.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed with Ensuite Bathroom2nd Floor: Master Bedroom: Full Bed with Ensuite BathroomGuest Bedroom: Full BedBunk Room: Two Twin-over-Full Bunkbeds Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17 mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here. Greenway station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Café, and more.The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila, to wings, burgers and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
